name: Default
shortDescription: Nomacs image viewer and light photo editor streamed to the browser behind a password, with settings and images kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. Keep images under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
